Mortars, Glows and Fire (Far Left side)

int.text: Melee Attack RX 4
Melee Attack RX 5
Starscream!  This is Brawl!  We're pinned down outside Zeta Prime's vaults!  We need air support!
But Megatron, there's too much firepower -
Yes, Megatron. Bombers, target these coordinates! Everyone else -- CLEAR THE STREET!
Bombers inbound!

fra.text: Bombardiers en approche !

int.text: Lord Megatron -- if I may make a suggestion? Disabling the anti-aircraft guns would open the way for our air support...

fra.text: Seigneur Megatron... j'ai peut-être une suggestion. On pourrait détruire leurs canons anti-aériens pour ouvrir la voie à notre soutien aérien...

int.text: Decepticons!  Take those guns!

fra.text: Decepticons ! Détruisez ces canons !

int.text: You heard Lord Megatron! Decepticons -- lay down cover fire while we take that building!
Now!  Hit the Autobots while they're distracted!

fra.text: Maintenant ! Attaquez-les pendant qu'ils sont occupés !

int.text: Transmitting the coordinates...

fra.text: Transmission des coordonnées...

int.text: The street looks clear, Megatron.

fra.text: Les rues sont dégagées, Megatron.

int.text: They're firing from the windows!

fra.text: Ils nous visent depuis les fenêtres !

int.text: Heads up!  More snipers!

fra.text: Attention ! Des tireurs d'élite !

int.text: We've got Autobot reinforcements headed our way!

fra.text: Des renforts Autobots viennent par ici !

int.text: They're coming from all directions!
No, no, no...there's NO way the Autobots would give up that easily.

fra.text: Non, non, non... Les Autobots ne vont pas abandonner aussi facilement.

int.text: BOMBING RUN WILL COMMENCE IN FIVE...FOUR...THREE...TWO...ONE!
That should've blown the Vault doors clear off!

fra.text: Les portes du Fort n'ont pas pu résister à cette attaque !

int.text: Jets attacking from above!
We've got hostiles on the roof!
Snipers on the bridge, Megatron!

fra.text: Tireurs d'élite sur le pont, Megatron !

int.text: We're being overrun!

fra.text: Ils sont trop nombreux !

int.text: War Cry 2

fra.text: [Cri de guerre 2]

int.text: War Cry 3

fra.text: [Cri de guerre 3]

int.text: Waiting for your orders, Megatron...
You can go on, Megatron -- I'll hold this position!
I won't let the Autobots re-take this position, Megatron. You can count on me!

fra.text: Les Autobots ne reprendront pas cette position, Megatron. Tu peux me faire confiance !

int.text: Good luck with the Omega Key, Megatron -- and give Zeta Prime a swift kick in the head for me.
Uh, Megatron...

fra.text: Euh, Megatron...

int.text: Why aren't we joining the main battle, Megatron?

fra.text: Pourquoi on ne participe pas à la bataille, Megatron ?

int.text: Autobots attacking! Hey, wasn't Starscream supposed to keep these guys occupied?
Tranquil contemplation? What does that even mean?
It's no use, Megatron! The door's locked!
The Omega what?
There's something off about that Starscream guy, Megatron. I don't trust him.
Are you serious? I'm feelin' pretty taxed, myself.
Wow.  That is one empty container.
Uh...not that I'm arguing or anything, but -- why don't we just go back to the dropship and hitch a ride?

fra.text: Hmm... C'est pas pour critiquer, mais pourquoi on ne retourne pas prendre le vaisseau, plutôt ?

int.text: You're joking, right?

fra.text: Tu plaisantes, hein ?

int.text: Hey Soundwave, you wanna race?

fra.text: Hé, Soundwave... on fait la course ?

int.text: Whoa!  Watch out!

fra.text: Ouah ! Attention !

int.text: What -- that's it? I was kind of having fun. In a high-speed, suicidal kind of way.

fra.text: Quoi, c'est déjà fini ? Dommage, c'était sympa... dans le sens suicidaire du terme.

int.text: Overhead -- Aerialbots!
Take cover!

fra.text: À couvert !

int.text: Are you insane?!?  I mean... yes, brilliant, Megatron!
The wreckage is in our way, Megatron.

fra.text: Les débris bloquent le passage, Megatron.

int.text: Hey! There's Autobots unloading off the train!
Snipers!  Across the street!
Well, THAT was a complete disaster.

fra.text: Eh bien, tu parles d'un désastre...

int.text: Turrets!  They're gonna chop us to pieces!
What the-?!?  That guy is huge!
You see that? *I* did that. ALL. Me.

fra.text: Vous avez vu ? C'est MOI qui ai tout fait !

int.text: Niiiice! Takes one gun to blow up the other!

fra.text: Joli ! J'adore détruire l'ennemi avec ses propres armes.

int.text: That almost punched our tickets! I thought Dark Energon was on our side?

fra.text: J'ai failli y laisser mon Spark ! Je croyais que l'énergon noir était de notre côté !?

int.text: The Autobots just keep coming!

fra.text: En voilà d'autres ! Ça n'en finit pas !

int.text: Megatron, they're everywhere! What do we do??

fra.text: Megatron, ils sont partout ! Qu'est-ce qu'on fait ?

int.text: That's -- that's the WHOLE AUTOBOT ARMY! We'll never--

fra.text: Ils sont TOUTE UNE ARMÉE !! On ne peut plus...

int.text: Wooooo-hoooo! BOOM! Eat THAT,  Autobots!
Aerialbots!--coming in fast!

fra.text: Des Aérobots viennent par ici !

int.text: On the roof over there!  More Autobots!
Blast those Autobot junk-heaps on the bridge!

fra.text: Explosez-moi ces minables, sur le pont !

int.text: They're right here on the rooftop!

fra.text: Ils ont réussi à atteindre le toit !

int.text: Oh great -- here we go...
The floor is glowing! It's everywhere! He's gonna smash us!
How can we win if he keeps making more clones?!?

fra.text: C'est sans espoir, il remplace tous les clones qu'on détruit !

int.text: Shoot the big glowy thing! SHOOT IT!!
Ceiling's coming down!  Get away from the mashers!
Wow...and here I thought ONE of this guy was annoying.

fra.text: Ouah... et dire qu'un seul Zeta Prime, c'était déjà trop.

int.text: Look! They've got Brawl outnumbered down there!

fra.text: Regardez ! On dirait que Brawl est en difficulté !

int.text: We're gonna get slaughtered!
That's it?!?  We beat 'em?
The tank's armor is too tough!  We gotta find a weak spot!
Come and get me, you over-sized rust-bucket!

fra.text: Allez ! Viens te battre, gros tas de rouille débile !

int.text: We can take him!  Just keep hittin' him with all you've got!

fra.text: On peut l'avoir ! Continuez à l'attaquer de toutes vos forces !

int.text: You can be SUCH a nerd, Soundwave!
Blasting his shield won't work!

fra.text: Inutile de tirer sur son bouclier !

int.text: Where?  I don't see anything...
They're all around us!

fra.text: Ils sont tout autour de nous !

int.text: Zeta's got one of our guys trapped!
Look at the floor!  What's Zeta up to?
Blast the batteries in the walls!  They've got Energon we can use!
Oh, come on...mines? Really?

fra.text: Quoi... des mines ? Sérieux ! ?

int.text: Skillful shooting.
Now I'm TRULY irritated.

fra.text: GROSSE erreur, Autobots !

int.text: You drilled that one good!

fra.text: Tu ne lui as laissé aucune chance !

int.text: Watch him crumple!

fra.text: Il a eu son compte !

int.text: Hurry up and smash the locks!

fra.text: Dépêchez-vous de détruire ces verrous !

int.text: We gotta turn off these lasers before we all get fried!

fra.text: On va tous finir désintégrés si on ne coupe pas ces lasers !

int.text: Train coming!  Get out of the way!
Soundwave, look out!

fra.text: Soundwave, attention !

int.text: Watch out, Megatron!  You're gonna get smushed!
Grab some cover!

Melee Attack RX 3

Death RX 1

Death RX 5
By the creator--!
I'm down!

fra.text: Ils m'ont eu...

int.text: Fatal error!

fra.text: Erreur critique !

int.text: Require--assitance!

fra.text: Besoin... d'aide...

int.text: Aggh, I'm hit!

fra.text: Argh, je suis touché !

int.text: Pull back! Pull back!

fra.text: Repli général ! En arrière !

int.text: Decepticon intruders!  They're inside the city!
Decepticons, down there!  Take 'em out!

fra.text: Des Decepticons, là en bas ! Abattez-les !

int.text: We've got to protect the anti-air guns!

fra.text: On doit protéger les canons anti-aériens !

int.text: Help... me...
ARRRRGGGGHHH!

fra.text: ARRRRGGGGHHH !

int.text: This is what you get for invading our city, Decepticon!
The Decepticons stop here! FOR ZETA PRIME!
Must... fight...  Must warn... Zeta Prime...
Death RX 1
Death RX 2
Death RX 3
Death RX 4
Death RX 5
Fall back!  Fall back!

fra.text: Repliez-vous ! En arrière !

int.text: Lord Megatron!  Help!

fra.text: Seigneur Megatron ! À l'aide !

int.text: Hey -- I'm still functional! I'M STILL F--
That Starscream guy is pretty cool.  Maybe he should be in charge...

fra.text: Ce Starscream a vraiment du style. C'est peut-être lui qui devrait commander...

int.text: Look! It's Megatron!

fra.text: Regarde ! C'est Megatron !

int.text: Shut UP! You trying to get us both killed?
AAAAAA!!!  I'm burning!!!
Go!  Go!  Go!

fra.text: Go ! Go ! Go !

int.text: Hey, guys!  Looks like it's all clear!
No WAY can we get past those turrets!

fra.text: On a AUCUNE chance de passer ces tourelles !

int.text: Don't let Megatron hear you say that!
About time.  Why'd he show up so late?
Hey, I'm good right here -- with my head OUT of the line of fire!
Initiating defense grid.

fra.text: Initialisation des systèmes de défense.

int.text: Security measures deactivated.

fra.text: Systèmes de sécurité désactivés.

int.text: Death RX 1
Death RX 2
While Starscream attacks Zeta Prime's armies head on, we shall move behind enemy lines and obtain the Omega Key.
Even the Autobots aren't foolish enough to leave the Stellar Galleries undefended. Destroy them!
I anticipated this. A powerful infusion of Dark Energon will bend the doors to my will!
Only the Autobots would build statues in honor of weaklings who fell in battle. Disgusting.
It means the Autobots laze about and whine over their own inadequacies. Ugh...what a waste of time and resources. Decepticons! Find the Omega Key!
You heard him! Blast the wall!

fra.text: Il fallait le dire ! Explosez ce mur !

int.text: Quickly! Infuse the batteries with Dark Energon!
A simple solution, then.  Break the locks!
Hahahahaha! For Glory!

fra.text: Ha, ha, ha, ha ! Je suis le meilleur !

int.text: Once I have access to the core, I will infuse it with Dark Energon and subject the entire planet's energy supply to MY WILL!
Excellent work, Soundwave. Now unlock the exit door.
Excellent, Starscream. Continue engaging them so that I can acquire the Omega Key.
Soundwave. Damage report.
MOVE, Decepticons! Double-time!

fra.text: Déployez-vous, Decepticons ! Exécution !

int.text: Move to that exit! NOW!

fra.text: Rejoignez cette sortie ! VITE !

int.text: Blow open that door!

fra.text: Faites sauter cette porte !

int.text: Move forward and flank them!  Let nothing stand in my way!
Oh, I trust Starscream about as far as I can blast him...but he shows a rare cunning that I find intriguing.
Excellent! This venture has proven far less taxing than I had anticipated.
Behold, Decepticons! The Omega Key!
Ah, Zeta Prime. I see you're still afraid to face me in person.
That is hardly a deterrent.  I will enjoy taking the Omega Key from your lifeless hands.
Soundwave, trace Zeta Prime's broadcast signal.
This is the shortest distance to travel, Breakdown.

fra.text: Je choisis toujours le chemin le plus court, Breakdown.

int.text: Into the tunnel, Decepticons.  And try not to get crushed by the trains.
Yes, Breakdown -- I am famous for my sparkling sense of humor. Now GET MOVING, before I dismantle you myself!
There -- that station. From there we can infiltrate the lower levels of Iacon.

fra.text: Là ! Cette station ! De là, on va pouvoir accéder aux niveaux inférieurs de Iacon.

int.text: Excellent!  The Omega Key awaits!
Decepticons -- ready your weaponry for battle!
Steady yourself, coward.  I marked this area for Dark Energon bombers.
Perfect! Soon Iacon will be no more than a thick layer of rubble!
Leave no Autobot alive!
Blast those Aerialbots!
Move out, Decepticons!
Stay on the tracks -- if you want to get smashed to pieces!
Excellent!  Brawl is already near the Omega Key!
If he dies, he's not worthy of the name Decepticon.
Let us speak with Brawl, then.  I want to hear how my war is going.
Witness the power of Dark Energon!
Brawl, call in the Dark Energon bombers!
DO AS I HAVE ORDERED, BRAWL!

fra.text: FAIS CE QUE JE DIS, BRAWL !

int.text: Silence!  Obviously our bombers are incompetent!
An excellent thought, Brawl. Carry it out.
No one turns back!  Destroy those guns by ANY means necessary!
Split up and flank him!  Use the debris for cover!
Onward, Decepticons.  Into the Vaults!
There!  The gun controls.

fra.text: Les commandes du canon sont là !

int.text: Move, Decepticons!

fra.text: Évacuez, Decepticons !

int.text: Brawl -- call in the bombers.
I see. When did they become YOUR ships, Starscream?
I shall make you pay for this, Starscream. Decepticons -- hold your positions until the bombers arrive!
Agreed, Brawl. Everyone hold fast and stay alert.
Stop your whining, Breakdown, or I'll stop it for you.
WE HOLD THEM OFF. The bombers will clear the street when they arrive! Rely on that!
Good. Brawl -- remain here and hold this position. The rest of us will move forward and acquire the Omega Key!

fra.text: Parfait. Brawl, reste ici et tiens cette position. Je vais continuer d'avancer avec les autres et récupérer la clé Omega !

int.text: Autobot Aerialbots!  Swat them out of the sky!
The Autobots think they can snipe us from the bridge!  Show them their error!
DESTROY THESE AUTOBOT WEAKLINGS!
Your pathetic machinery won't stop me, Zeta Prime!
Finally!  The Omega Key is within my -
Come down HERE, Zeta Prime, and I will give you the answer!
Your theatrics don't frighten me, Zeta.
Is that all, Zeta?  A pathetic army of energon clones?  Is that the best you can do?
More Zeta clones!  Destroy them!
He's recharging.  Fire at the core!
Stay off the glowing floors if you wish to live!
Your machine is failing, Zeta Prime.  Where are your boasts now?
Endless duplicates of ZetaPrime - how nauseating!
Descend here. And have a care -- one wrong step, and you're scrap metal.
Impossible!

fra.text: Impossible !

int.text: Decepticons -- target the fuel cell on the back of the tank!
We've breached its armor! Now DESTROY IT!
He's weakening, Decepticons!  Tear him apart!

fra.text: Il commence à s'affaiblir ! Achevez-le, Decepticons !

int.text: Quit wasting firepower! You can't penetrate his shield!

fra.text: Économisez vos forces ! On ne peut pas transpercer son bouclier !

int.text: What?!?

fra.text: Comment !?

int.text: Starscream - continue forward and meet Zeta Prime's armies on the front line!
Do not fail me!

fra.text: Je l'espère pour toi !

int.text: The Autobots are here, no doubt skulking in the shadows.
Return fire!  Destroy anything that moves!
Idiot. Decepticons! Onward!
We need energon!  Break open the batteries on the walls!

fra.text: On a besoin d'énergon ! Détruisez les batteries accrochées aux murs !

int.text: Your mines inspire no fear in ME, Autobots!
I laugh at your pitiful attempts to harm me!
Onward!  Through that door!
What are you waiting for?
Hurry!  Destroy the batteries!
Don't get hit by the train, you fool!
Soundwave, move quickly or Zeta will crush you!
Breakdown, you fool!  MOVE!
A fine display of marksmanship.
Now...time for more strategic slaughter!

fra.text: Et maintenant, le carnage peut reprendre !

int.text: Megatron, the gate to the Stellar Galleries is locked.
The Autobots maintain these rooms for tranquil contemplation.
Scans reveal poor structural integrity surrounding this maintenance access door.
Megatron -- those batteries feed the security grid.

fra.text: Megatron ! Ces batteries alimentent leur grille défensive.

int.text: Scans show minimal damage.
The Omega Key grants access to the Core of Cybertron.
Be aware -- snipers at the entrance.
Megatron, our data indicates that the Omega Key is located just beyond that door.
Commencing scan...Complete.  Its origin is 12.7 cycles ahead.
Megatron -- the city subsystems provide a direct line to the broadcast's origin.
Negative.
Megatron -- Omega Key detected. We should proceed through the logistics station.
Megatron -- sensors indicate approaching Autobot energy signatures.
Megatron -- that structure is collapsing!
Megatron -- the debris scans as stable enough to support our weight.
Megatron -- I have detected the Omega Key. It lies beyond the train tunnel.

fra.text: Megatron. J'ai détecté la clé Omega. Elle se trouve au-delà du tunnel ferroviaire.

int.text: Megatron -- the area is now clear.

fra.text: Megatron. Le périmètre est sécurisé.

int.text: Megatron -- the tank has been rendered non-functional.
Megatron -- the controls are overloading.
Megatron, we may be able to damage Zeta's machinery during its recharge cycle.
Megatron, we must find a way to destroy the control center.
Megatron -- Zeta Prime's machine core is now vulnerable.
Alert. ALERT. Zeta Prime is modifying the room.
The Energon composition of these clones is remarkable.
Megatron -- the back of the tank is the only location vulnerable to our weapons.
Warning: the tank's cannon is still fully operational.
Megatron -- the Autobot's systems are approaching critical.
Zeta Prime's shield has proven impenetrable.
Autobots incoming!

fra.text: Autobots en approche !

int.text: Megatron -- sensors indicate Autobot energy signatures nearby.
Destroy the wall batteries.  That will recharge your energon stores.
Autobot Cloakers present.

fra.text: Furtifs Autobots détectés.

int.text: Cloakers present. Be aware.

fra.text: Attention. Je détecte des Furtifs.

int.text: The Cloakers present a unique threat. Eliminate them.
Cloakers are to be destroyed on sight.

fra.text: Tous les Furtifs ennemis doivent être détruits.

int.text: Acceptable marksmanship.
Your marksmanship is appropriate.
Adequate marksmanship displayed.

fra.text: Ta technique de tir est au point.

int.text: Scans indicate that the batteries power the security grid.
Megatron, beware Zeta's machinery.

fra.text: Fais attention aux pièges de Zeta, Megatron !

int.text: Breakdown -- engage evasive action!
Megatron -- the Dark Energon is proving every bit as formidable as you predicted! The Autobot armies crumble before it!
Brawl, this is Starscream!  Your request is denied.  I won't have you wasting more of my ships!
Oh -- Lord Megatron! I didn't realize YOU were there!
Air support request approved -- but it will be a few cycles before the bombers can reach you. I'm afraid you'll just have to be patient.
Have no fear, Lord Megatron! Under my leadership, Decepticon victory is assured!
Engaging Decepticons at the Iacon Vaults.

fra.text: Élimination des Decepticons engagée.

int.text: Megatron, I'm warning you right now. You are toying with forces beyond your understanding or control.
Ha! Predictable as ever, right down to the empty words. The Omega Key is under MY protection now, Megatron.
You cannot hope to overcome my defenses, Megatron!

fra.text: Tu n'as aucune chance de surmonter mes défenses, Megatron !

int.text: Did you really think it would be that easy?

fra.text: Tu croyais vraiment que ce serait aussi simple ?

int.text: I shall remain where I am -- this vantage point will provide an excellent view of your destruction.
Do you see now, Megatron?  This is my domain.
Here, I have the power to control...and create...
HAHAHAHA! You have NO idea! Here, I have limitless power!
My will controls this entire chamber, Megatron. I need only close my hand to crush the life out of you!
I can easily create more energon clones! You WILL be destroyed!
In this chamber, MY will reigns supreme, Megatron!
A valiant attempt, Decepticons, but Autobot machinery is more resilient than you realize.
The battle is far from over, Decepticon!  Prepare for destruction!
No! Systems failing...this cannot be!
It's only a matter of time before you're overwhelmed!

fra.text: Votre énergie finira par s'épuiser, c'est inévitable !

int.text: There is nowhere to run, Decepticons.
Do you see how futile your struggle is, Megatron?
Ha! Your weapons are useless against me!

fra.text: Ah ! Vos armes sont sans effet sur moi !

Autobots, this is Zeta Prime.  Any Decepticon activity must be reported immediately, and all Decepticons are to be shot on sight! Zeta Prime out!
